description: This file defines functions and data structures for loading and querying detection data, including reading from CSV files or using embedded sample data. It provides interfaces for loading detection records, filtering detections, and handling detection data with specific structure and types.

methods.name: Tuple[List[Dict[str,Any]],datetime] load_detections()
methods.description: Loads detection data from a CSV file specified by the environment variable or defaults to embedded sample data. Returns detections sorted by frame time and the current UTC datetime.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _load_from_csv(path: str)
methods.description: Reads detection data from a CSV file, converting each row to the appropriate types and filtering out invalid rows.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] _load_from_embedded_sample()
methods.description: Provides embedded sample detection data matching expected structure.

methods.name: List[Dict[str,Any]] query_detections( detections: List[Dict[str, Any]], label: Optional[str] = None, min_confidence: Optional[float] = None, start_time: Optional[float] = None, end_time: Optional[float] = None, )
methods.description: Filters a list of detection records based on label, confidence, and time range criteria.

ctags.name: query_detections
ctags.signature: ( detections: List[Dict[str, Any]], label: Optional[str] = None, min_confidence: Optional[float] = None, start_time: Optional[float] = None, end_time: Optional[float] = None, )
